identity.title: B1-A: Native source/PIT scout and research to existing W01 Hermes and forecast consumer spine
identity.objective: Connect existing offline A1 scout and A2 sourced PIT output to existing W01 A3/A4 native Hermes/Alpha consumer and frozen forecast diagnostics with cold-verifiable provenance, truthful denominators and no provider or economic authority.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert exactly the 11 B1-A paths. All existing source/PIT, forecast, experiment, Hermes W01, Alpha stores and source-contract modules remain unchanged; only disposable offline test registry inputs may be appended via existing W01 operator. No runtime/provider/venue/host state.

api_matrix.reason: Add one thin, offline-only producer-consumer bridge and a CLI without changing the existing canonical source, market, forecast, Hermes or Alpha schemas.

items.before: Existing source/PIT scout, source-grounding, native forecast, W01 delegated specialist and Alpha consumers are separately callable, but a single canonical case/receipt handoff is not established.
items.after: Small read-only validation/adapter that binds existing native identities and cold-verifiable source+forecast inputs to W01 without minting market or source IDs; explicit admitted/refused/skipped denominator.
items.compatibility_requirement: No schema change, no second registry, no edit to preexisting source/forecast/W01/Alpha modules; synthetic and offline only, no economic admission.

items.before: Separately callable pre-existing tools for source grounding, SDK mock search, Hermes W01 and forecast evaluation.
items.after: One finite manually invoked operator with run and cold verify; uses the actual existing operators and frozen input bytes, not the model as the identity authority.
items.compatibility_requirement: No loop, daemon, real GET, model spend, provider, runtime home, credential or production Alpha mutation; no historical receipt reinterpretation.

semantic_fields.reason: Nine normative, test-linked producer/consumer and boundary requirements; reuse native canonical serialization and cold verification.

No edits to separately owned PR #268 or Lane B; collision only on deferred-items documentation may be reconciled after separate Karl decision.
